inspiration.source_location: mysql56-save_history.sql: JSON-derived INSERT ... SELECT and ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE section
inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL migration expands JSON-derived rows into an INSERT SELECT and uses ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE to make repeated materialization idempotent.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a device-preference loader. JSON_TABLE extracts each preference and its FOR ORDINALITY position from per-device payloads; an INSERT SELECT updates one existing preference, inserts new preferences, and leaves an unrelated device untouched.

fixture_notes: Device 1201 has a legacy theme preference that is updated from JSON and receives a new ordered timezone preference; device 1202 receives a new preference; unrelated device 1203 remains unchanged.
determinism_notes: Device IDs, JSON arrays, preference keys, ordinality values, primary keys, and ORDER BY clauses are fixed; the fixture has no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections.
setup: CREATE TABLE device_preference_payloads (device_id INT PRIMARY KEY, payload JSON NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE device_preferences (device_id INT NOT NULL, preference_key VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, preference_value VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, preference_position INT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (device_id, preference_key))

steps.sql: INSERT INTO device_preferences (device_id, preference_key, preference_value, preference_position) SELECT p.device_id, jt.preference_key, jt.preference_value, jt.preference_position FROM device_preference_payloads AS p CROSS JOIN JSON_TABLE(p.payload, '$.preferences[*]' COLUMNS (preference_position FOR ORDINALITY, preference_key VARCHAR(32) PATH '$.key', preference_value VARCHAR(64) PATH '$.value')) AS jt ORDER BY p.device_id, jt.preference_position ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE preference_value = VALUES(preference_value), preference_position = VALUES(preference_position)

checks.sql: SELECT device_id, preference_key, preference_value, preference_position FROM device_preferences ORDER BY device_id, preference_position, preference_key
